semantics: Explicit inactive/cleared and valid resolved invalidations allow unchanged exact original replay
Bound missing/malformed active invalidation or malformed resolution times fail closed
Ordinary cache metadata without invalidation fields remains valid
Original/sourceUrl/finalUrl and exact evidence/cache/source-ID bindings share one predicate
Case inventory original keeps byte/SHA verification; valid resolution no longer permanently blocks imports/reviews
Aggregate case fingerprint includes retained evidence descriptor hashes; another descriptor swap revokes prior manual review
Basket invalidation uses the same shared predicate; no original/quote auto-removal or collection resume
